evidence.name: Screen field: How the image fills its area
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How the image fills its area" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How the image fills its area
sections.description: Decides how your image or video fits the section. Fill covers the whole area and crops the edges that don't fit — best for full-bleed hero shots and the right pick for most ad creatives. Fit shows the entire image but may leave blank bars around it; use it when nothing can be cropped. Stretch forces an exact fit but distorts the picture, so avoid it for photos.
